title: Omens of the Bell
drawHint: Read an omen for the party as they step into the nave
usage: Draw one each time the party enters the nave while the bell is silent. It lasts until they leave the undercroft.

cards.name: Cracked Bell
cards.subtitle: Omen of Warning
cards.body: A far-off note, like a bell struck under water.

effects.heading: Boon Effect
effects.body: The next time a character would be [[surprise|surprised]] in the undercroft, they are not.

effects.heading: Bane Effect
effects.body: The [[bell-warden]] has advantage on its first attack roll.

cards.name: Guttering Candle
cards.subtitle: Omen of the Dead
cards.body: Every flame the party carries leans toward the ringers' stair.

effects.heading: Boon Effect
effects.body: The party knows the way to the ringers' stair ([[L1 area 5]]) without looking for it.

effects.heading: Bane Effect
effects.body: The ringers hear the party coming, and cannot be surprised.

cards.name: Silver in the Dark
cards.subtitle: Omen of Hope
cards.body: A glint of silver at the corner of the eye, gone when anyone looks.

effects.heading: Boon Effect
effects.body: One character gains the benefit of [[bless]] until the end of their next fight.

effects.heading: Bane Effect
effects.body: [[grask]] feels the clapper's pull, and is awake when the party reaches him.

cards.name: Rope Without a Bell
cards.subtitle: Omen of Silence
cards.body: A bell-rope swings in the dark with nothing on its end.

effects.heading: Boon Effect
effects.body: The party moves in silence: advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until they leave the nave.

effects.heading: Bane Effect
effects.body: Sound dies here. A spell with a verbal component fails on a roll of 1 on a d6.
